Name: A Weird Cat
Author: stylbash
Description:
I felt that there was an appalling lack of possum pet replacers, so I fixed it. [s]This [i]ought[/i] to be seasonal friendly, with the possum changing into a sweater for the fall and winter, but it's untested.[/s] Now tested! It works! I've also put up a sweaterless, non seasonal option. Both versions are updated with new coding and some  spriting issues resolved as of 1.1.

Content Patcher friendly, requires SMAPI. Unzip the file and put it into your /Mods folder.

Mods seen in my screenshots:

Downloads.Description: Seasonal Possum. Unzip and place into your /Mods folder. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. Updated with fixed coding.
Optional non seasonal weird cat. Unzip and place in your /Mods folder. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. Fixed some spriting issues.
